dimensionFindings.visualHierarchy: The first viewport now establishes a clear market-intelligence hierarchy: Njia identity, market thesis, bounded reading card, then query and command surfaces. Downstream sections are differentiated without losing continuity.
dimensionFindings.typography: Editorial serif display type and compact sans data type remain distinctive while micro-labels were raised into a more legible range. The dense intelligence aesthetic still uses intentionally compact metadata, keeping this below exceptional.
dimensionFindings.layoutSpacing: Section rhythm, panel gutters, market cards and evidence groups are substantially more consistent. The long mobile page is inherent to the preserved information architecture rather than overflow.
dimensionFindings.componentQuality: Signal cards, opportunity table, product panels, evidence timeline, buyer radar and evidence disclosures now share a coherent border, surface, state and density system.
dimensionFindings.uxClarity: The journey reads signal -> question -> ranked opportunity -> investigation -> evidence. Sticky navigation maintains orientation on the long intelligence page and all original destinations are preserved.
dimensionFindings.interactionPolish: Native details behavior, clearer open/hover treatment, keyboard-visible focus and sticky navigation improve feedback without introducing fragile custom interaction logic. Static-prototype scope limits richer application states.
dimensionFindings.responsiveExecution: Real Chromium renders at 390, 820 and 1440 pixels show exact viewport-width documents with no page overflow; signal cards step through 5/3/2/1-column behavior and complex panels stack without structural loss.
dimensionFindings.brandDistinction: Warm mineral paper, deep green-black ink, restrained rust signals, editorial typography and evidence-led composition create a recognizable Kenyan commercial-intelligence identity rather than generic SaaS styling.
dimensionFindings.accessibility: Keyboard focus, native details controls, semantic headings/table structure, mobile keyboard navigation, reduced-motion handling and normal-text contrast all pass the browser evidence suite. Repaired small-text token contrasts range from 5.07:1 to 6.08:1 on tested surfaces.
dimensionFindings.statesAndFeedback: Hover, focus, disclosure-open and mobile-navigation states are explicit and restrained. Broader loading/empty/error states are outside the static artifact's preserved behavior and therefore prevent an exceptional score.
